title: Oikonomikos (Arabic Tadbīr al-manzil, 'Management of the Estate'); RU: Брисон, «Ойкономикос»
author: Bryson (Neopythagorean)
language: Arabic (Greek lost; Hebrew and Latin versions derive from it)
edition: Plessner 1928, Arabic + German (archive.org); Swain 2013 critical edition.
ru_evidence: No ru.wiki hits; Solopova 2018 lists no Russian translation.
en_evidence: Swain, Economy, Family, and Society from Rome to Islam (CUP 2013), per reviews indexed in OpenAlex.
value: The only imperial-age Greek oikonomikos (household-management treatise) surviving in full. Covers slaves, wives, children and wealth; it shaped Miskawayh and Tusi. Useful to economic and social historians.
ai_feasibility: High (Arabic, short); the German and English translations are available for cross-checking.
